retainedReads.retire: Retire after two idle minutes, with up to five minutes on adaptive reuse. Closing the canonical state path joins its retained pool.

dedicatedInspection.retire: Join the worker before releasing snapshot pins or finishing maintenance. Retain custody for retry if retirement fails.

subscriptions.retire: Close stdin after the last directory subscription releases; macOS also rolls over the shared helper.

parentMonitor.retire: Exit with the watch host; stop the host when its owner PID disappears.

retainedCapture.retire: Close the pool when the last capture client releases its artifacts and roots. Runtime shutdown drains the remaining clients.

pooledRequests.retire: Rotate history and search lanes after five idle minutes and other lanes after 90 seconds. Pool-level idle timeouts, memory pressure, and shutdown can retire idle slots earlier.

startupPrewarm.retire: Reuse the history lane for existing stores after Gateway readiness with Control UI enabled and sufficient memory. The lane rotates after five idle minutes, or earlier under pressure or shutdown.

operatorConnectPrewarm.retire: The operator connection reuses the history lane for existing stores. Repeated prewarms share work by database and lane without refreshing its idle deadline.

leanHosted.retire: Follow the pool's retirement policy and await endpoint cleanup. The last endpoint joins the host. Failed stops or missed acknowledgements force host retirement.

gatewayCommands.retire: Retire with the Gateway owner; startup admits this mode only on qualified Linux hosts.

nativeResourceClaims.retire: Apply NATIVE_BROKER_IDLE_MS after claims and workers release; process-exit pins remain owned by the runtime.

pooledReads.retire: Apply the pool's idle TTL and memory-pressure policy after the read returns.

scopedSync.retire: Close the read-only child with its lexical inspection scope.

oneShot.retire: The inspection command owns child completion and cancellation.

retainedSnapshots.retire: Rotate the worker after the last preparation and retained directory release. Runtime shutdown drains admitted preparations and joins the pool.

retainedReads.retire: Use base idle timeouts of 30 minutes for the primary worker and 30 seconds for surplus workers. Source shutdown seals admission, drains accepted reads, and joins the pools.

awaitedInspection.retire: Retire a standalone reader on task close after its read. Admission and maintenance can reuse the worker. Read or native cleanup failures force retirement.

postgresSnapshotExporter.retire: Hold the snapshot until its consumers release it, then join the exporter task, retire the worker, and close the dedicated pool.

leanHosted.retire: Follow the pool's retirement policy and await endpoint cleanup. The last endpoint joins the host. Failed stops or missed acknowledgements force host retirement.

defaultSource.retire: Unreference the idle supervisor and keep it reusable until runtime cleanup joins it.

retainedGeneration.retire: Unreference the idle supervisor. Generation cleanup joins its execution owners and supervisor before releasing the captured runtime.
